spans.s:
म्लक्ष् r. 10th cl. (म्लक्षयति-ते)
 1. To mix, to unite.
 2. To speak incorrectly.

म्लान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
 1. Foul, dirty.
 2. Languid, weary.
 3. Faded,
withered.
 4. Melancholy.
 E. म्लै to be languid, aff. क्त ।

म्लानि f. (-निः)
 1. Weariness, languor.
 2. Foulness, filth.
 3. Fading,
decay.
 4. Sadness.
 E. म्लै to be languid, &c., aff. क्तिन् ।

म्लास्नु f. (-स्नु)
 1. Growing languid.
 2. Growing thin.
 3. Growing withered.
